visual_logic.color_palette: Moss green and mud-brown; the crest is a vibrant, neon-flecked turquoise.
visual_logic.pattern_strategy: Dappled 'swamp' camouflage; the crest has a translucent, gelatinous look at the top edge.

pose: Wading through the shallows; the head is held low to the water, making the tall, vertical crest the highest point of the silhouette.
